notes: Rebuilt Bar tools shelf: 2 old kinds (Cocktail shaker k88, Jigger k89) kept and 9 new kinds added per plan (Bar spoon, Cocktail strainer, Mixing glass, Muddler, Corkscrew, Wine preserver, Ice bucket, Ice mould, Bar set). Shaker types (Boston/cobbler/Parisian), strainer types (Hawthorne/julep/fine), corkscrew mechanisms and preserver mechanisms are attribute-level 't' entries, not kinds. Archetypes added: Koriko tins, Alessi 870, Yukiwa Baron, Birdy CS500; Leopold jigger; Teardrop and Birdy spoons; Koriko Hawthorne and CK julep; Yarai; Screwpull, Laguiole sommelier, Pulltap's, Rabbit; Coravin, Vacu Vin, Vinturi; Alessi 871; Tovolo sphere and Japanese ice ball mould. Left out: Tovolo and Vinturi brand entries (no brand page retrieved, so mk left empty); OXO and Oster kept as plain models for the same reason; Yukiwa founding year and Cocktail Kingdom founding year omitted (not confirmed on retrieved pages); Wikipedia lookups for Alessi/OXO/Forge de Laguiole failed on a tool lock, so Alessi facts are limited to its own product page. Jigger keeps its old source URL. Wine sleeve covered as an Ice bucket type and Vacu Vin Active Cooler model; no separate kind.
